seo.title: Venom Guitars — Australian Custom Guitar Builders
seo.description: Venom Guitars — Custom Australian-made electric guitars. Hand-crafted with Australian hardwoods, deadly tone, venom-level quality.

s7.k2: Custom electric guitars — forged in Australia

s8.k3: At Venom Guitars we have a dream to manufacture an all-Australian range of professional custom guitars for our customers. Our goal is to build a recognisable brand in the Australian music industry — one that earns respect from the ground up.
s8.k4: We want Venom Guitars to be recognised by grassroots and professional musicians alike, initially in Australia, and ultimately to become a globally recognised brand. We're a supportive force in the music industry, providing high-quality instruments customised to each player's exact specifications.
s8.k5: We use a range of Australian and international hardwoods and resins to create musical works of art — guitars that look as dangerous as they sound.

s9.k3: Each Venom guitar is built to spec, using Australian timbers and resin art bodies that are as wild as the country that inspired them.
s9.k6: Inspired by Australia's most iconic serpent. Resin art body, hot single-coil pickups.
s9.k9: Built for the heavy hitter. Mahogany body, twin humbucker bite.
s9.k12: Compact, thick-set and lightning fast. Short-scale body with a venomous bite.
s9.k15: A deadly bite in a small package. Sleek body with the signature red stripe.
s9.k18: Australia's most feared. Aggressive lines for an aggressive tone.
s9.k21: Your vision, our craft. Full custom builds from tone woods to finish.

s10.k4: We work with you to nail the spec — body shape, tonewoods, pickups, hardware. Every build starts with a conversation.
s10.k6: We source premium Australian hardwoods — Blackwood, Rosewood, Silky Oak — alongside international tone timbers for the perfect sonic foundation.
s10.k8: Hand-routed bodies, precision neck joints, bound fretboards. Each piece is shaped, sanded, and fitted by human hands. No shortcuts.
s10.k10: Resin art pours, lacquer finishes, full professional set-up. Your guitar plays perfectly before it leaves the shop.

s11.k4: Commission your custom Venom Guitar. We build to order — every spec tailored to your playing style, your tone, your look.

s12.k3: Raw footage. Sawdust, lacquer fumes, and the satisfaction of a perfectly dressed fret. Follow our builds from blank to complete.
